title: ProjectActivityService
responsibility: Shows the activity of the repository a checkout belongs to: recorded work from Git and, live, its checkouts and agents.

inputs.name: ProjectActivityService.constructor.root
inputs.description: The path of the checkout this service is built for, as given: `show` picks the Git worktree at this path (or the first one Git lists when none matches), and reads the history, notes, loops and unit registry of that checkout. The value is not checked here; outside Git, the path itself is the only checkout.

inputs.name: ProjectActivityService.show.limit
inputs.description: How many of the newest commits the live view covers: `show` uses it as the most revisions `SourceHistoryRepository.read` returns and as the work limit of `projectActivity`, with no check or clamping. It has no effect when the checkout has no head, because then no history is read.

inputs.name: ProjectActivityService.recorded.history
inputs.description: The source history the index was built from: its first revision is the newest and sets the head, the branch whose head is that commit gives the repository's branch, and only its first 30 revisions become work items. Its changed files come from all of its revisions, up to 40 distinct paths.

revisions.subject: Show the agent roster in project activity
revisions.author: Mira Halvorsen

revisions.subject: Count unreadable agent registrations apart from the roster
revisions.author: Tomas Ruiz

inputs.name: ProjectActivityService.recorded.details
inputs.description: The RevisionDetail of each commit, keyed by commit hash: `recorded` reads the registry units (their `id` and `owns.source`) of the newest commit, and, for the commits it lists, their `explanations` and `sourceImpact.changed` paths. A commit without an entry adds no units, reasons or changed paths.

outputs.name: ProjectActivityService.show
outputs.description: The resolved value: `activity` is the committed work of the repository's history, with the loops the checkout has now, and `live` is the state of the checkouts and agents when it was read: up to 12 worktrees, each with up to 40 uncommitted changes, the agent roster, and the `sampledAt` time.

outputs.name: ProjectActivityService.recorded
outputs.description: The resolved ProjectActivity of kind `recorded`, built from the history and details it is given: at most 30 work items, each with at most 3 reasons and 12 units, and at most 40 files. It also reads Git for the repository name, from the primary worktree, and for the loops at the newest commit.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by `show` and `recorded` when every worktree Git lists is bare or prunable, so that no checkout is left: `show` then reads `head` of undefined, and `recorded` reads `path` of undefined.

errors.name: BoundedCommandFailure
errors.description: Rejected by the Git commands of `show` and `recorded` that run through `GitAdapter.exec`, when git cannot be started, runs past its deadline, or writes more output than its bound. Its message gives the cause, such as the deadline that was exceeded.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by `show` when one of its Git reads exits non-zero: the ref listing, the commit walk, the history log, the changed-files log, or the note blob read. Its message is `git <arguments> failed:` followed by git's stderr.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejected by `show` when a directory it lists cannot be read, with a system error such as EACCES or ENOTDIR: the unit registry (`specification/units`), the loops (`specification/loops`), or a checkout's agent registry (`.cache/harness/agents`).

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown by `show` when the latest heartbeat of an agent has an `at` that is not a valid date, because the roster calls `toISOString()` on the expiry computed from it; the registry accepts any non-empty string as `at`.
